analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 상승 후 횡보 구간 진입. RSI는 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간에서 횡보 중이며, MACD 히스토그램은 개선세를 보이나 아직 골든크로스 미형성. ADX 48.3으로 추세 강도는 유지되나, -DI가 +DI보다 우위에 있어 하락 압력 잔존. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 동일한 $55,149.57로 Higher Low 패턴 확인. 현재가 $62,985.48은 스윙 지지선 $62,553.19에 근접. 변동성 ATR $3,025.85 대비 손절폭 1.3배($3,933.6), 목표 2.6배($7,867.2) 설정 시 진입가 $62,985.48, 손절가 $59,051.88, 목표가 $70,852.68. 손익비 1.99. 그러나 주봉 RSI 37.8, 주봉 MACD 히스토그램 -1674.3078로 여전히 약세 구간. 다중 시간대 정렬 부족으로 관망.
analysis.reasonEn: Entered a consolidation phase after 3 consecutive days of gains. RSI has exited oversold territory and is consolidating in the neutral zone, while MACD histogram shows improvement but no golden cross yet. ADX at 48.3 indicates strong trend, but -DI remains above +DI, suggesting lingering downside pressure. Confirmed Higher Low pattern with 5-day and 20-day lows at $55,149.57. Current price $62,985.48 is near the swing support at $62,553.19. With ATR of $3,025.85, setting stop loss at 1.3x ATR ($3,933.6) and target at 2.6x ATR ($7,867.2) yields entry $62,985.48, stop $59,051.88, target $70,852.68, with a risk-reward ratio of 1.99. However, weekly RSI at 37.8 and weekly MACD histogram at -1674.3078 remain in bearish territory. Lack of multi-timeframe alignment warrants a wait-and-see approach.

· Below SMA100 ($77,610.9) and SMA200 ($72,240.96): indicating mid-to-long term bearish trend.

· MACD histogram trajectory (-1024.3258 → -427.7530): improving but still bearish, no trend reversal signal formed.

[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($62,553.19): based on pivot and SMA5.
· Swing resistance ($65,401.69): breakthrough expected to lead to a short-term bounce.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.96x): moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): wait-and-see conditions due to lack of multi-timeframe alignment.
